summary: One POST form (login-form) at /account/login/ on pypi.org, then a second page at /account/two-factor/ with a POST form for an authenticator code beside a security-key form. The site's source is public; its fields are rendered by a form library.

sources.title: PyPI (warehouse) login template at the head of the main branch on the review date
PyPI (warehouse) account forms: username and totp_value are string fields, password is a password field
WTForms 3.2.2, the version PyPI pins: an input is written with id and name equal to the field name, the widget's type, and the keyword arguments of the template call as attributes
PyPI (warehouse) functional test: fills the rendered forms login-form and totp-auth-form through the field names username, password and totp_value
PyPI (warehouse) requirements: WTForms is pinned to exactly 3.2.2

fixtures.note: Both forms of the page: the security-key form with its own submit button, and the authenticator form.

staysInteractive.note: An account with only a security key has no authenticator form on the second page.
The authenticator code is filled only with a saved secret and automatic 2FA turned on.
A sign-in from a device the site has not seen is redirected to /account/confirm-login/ and waits for the link in an email.
Recovery codes are a separate page.

notes: The hosted page was not captured: pypi.org/robots.txt (read 2026-10-12) disallows /account/ for every user agent. The site has no release numbers and deploys from its main branch, so the cited commit is the source as of the review date, not a pinned release; later changes are not covered. No CAPTCHA is part of the login form in this source (it is used on registration).
